about: HDTP §12 call budgets: every decision and row of BatonDeck's RateLimiter.take over these sequences, as the TypeScript named in `source` decided them, recorded on 2026-09-28 (batondeck is a private repository whose history was rewritten on 2026-10-01; 6c771f7 and b781b53 are hashes of the history before that, the last of them with limits.ts as it was from 449b273 of 2026-09-28 until the limiter's removal). A fixed record: the cloud's limiter was removed on 2026-09-29 (batondeck ba68f9c, its plan's M-C3), and the cloud decides through this library's `limits_decide` since, so there is no TypeScript left to make it again, and the generator that ran it (js/limits-vectors.mjs) was deleted with that. Replayed by crates/hdtp-limits/tests/vectors.rs, js/limits.test.mjs (the Wasm and the Go adapter) and go/limits_test.go; the rows the cloud wrote before the move read the same after it because these hold the crate to the TypeScript's arithmetic, bit for bit.
shape: a step is [charge, now, outcome, writes]: outcome 0 when let through, [retry_after, refused_by] when refused; writes [[bucket, tokens, updated_at], ...] in charge order, empty when refused
fixtures: guest_total_calls_per_hour and pending_in_cap: the TypeScript had neither rule, so no step exercises them.
